I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 141-seat figure, so I'm treating it as unverified.

Nothing in #central-team or the shared files I can see mentions the Moorland rollout or a seat count for Marrow Fieldworks. The only related note I found says the Marrow Fieldworks account changed hands on 5 Jan 2026, and it has no seat numbers. I asked for someone to check the count against the account's CRM or order record and post the confirmed number in the thread.

No approval was needed, because a seat count isn't a finance figure.
